title: Trace-led metric shadowing playbook
content:
Purpose and scope
- Short goal: run an experiment that uses trace anchors to 'shadow' new metric variants alongside current production metrics to validate signal fidelity before swapping dashboards and alerts.
- Why: reduce false positives when we change metric granularity, aggregation windows, or add tenant-scoped tags.
- Out of scope: changing SLOs or alert thresholds in this experiment. Those come after validation.

High-level hypotheses
1) A trace-anchored microaggregation will identify the top 3 hidden variance sources in time-to-first-token for small-context requests.
2) Tenant-scoped latencies show different quantile drift patterns than global aggregates; shadowed metrics will reveal which tenants drive alert noise.

Experiment design
- Duration: 2 weeks of steady traffic + 48 hours smoke and 48 hours tail analysis.
- Sampling: capture full traces for 1% of requests, PSI-based adaptive sampling to increase to 5% during detected anomalies.
- Shadow metrics: compute new metric variants in parallel, write to telemetry namespace telemetry_shadow.metric_name.v2 with suffix tags shadow=true. No backfill.
- Trace anchors: add span tag trace_anchor_id and link it to metrics via propagation id header X-Trace-Anchor.

Metric definitions (explicit, query-ready)
- ttf_token_ms_v1 (current): p50, p90, p99 of time from request_start to first_token_emitted, aggregated at 1m resolution, global tenant=all.
- ttf_token_v2_shadow: same raw event but recorded with tenant_id, model_variant, kv_cache_hit boolean, and session_warmth bucket. Aggregations: p50/p75/p90/p95/p99 at 30s resolution.
- kv_prefetch_rate_shadow: ratio of requests that hit kv cache on first call, computed per tenant per 5m. Use count_if(kv_hit)/count(total).
- slot_utilization_estimated: sampled estimate of GPU slot occupancy from trace durations, exported as gauge per node. Shadow variant records node labels and model_family.

Tracing annotations and span contract recommendations
- New required span labels for shadows: trace_anchor_id, tenant_id, model_variant_tag, kv_cache_hit, session_warmth, route_fallback_reason (nullable).
- Span naming: keep current noun-verb format but append '.shadow' on spans that trigger the shadowging path to make trace filtering trivial.
- Retention: full payload for sampled traces stored for 14 days; minimal metadata for 90 days. Ensure traces link to metric shards via trace_anchor_id.

Dashboard composition guidance
- Landing page: 3 tiles side-by-side
  1) Global ttf token p90 comparison v1 vs shadow v2 (delta panel)
  2) Tenant noise map (heatmap by tenant showing p95 delta)
  3) Trace sample list (recent anomalies with links to trace viewer)
- Drill panels: kv cache warm/cold split, per-model variant deltas, node slot_utilization scatter.
- Widget behavior: default to show shadow=false overlay but allow toggle to show shadow=true only. Provide percentile sliders to compare windows.

Analysis checklist (what to validate before promoting v2)
- Correlation: p95 delta between v1 and v2 explains > 85% of variance when traced anchor is present.
- Noise reduction: tenant-level alert rate decreases or remains equal when switching to tenant-scoped metrics for top 10 tenants by volume.
- Reproducibility: For 5 representative incident traces, metric deltas point to same root cause bucket (kv hit vs model_variant vs infra).
- Query cost: v2 query cost estimated not to exceed 1.5x current for dashboard queries.

Alert and SLI considerations
- Do not change alert thresholds in this experiment. Instead, record hypothetical thresholds for v2 and compute what the firing rate would have been.
- Map SLIs to traces by trace_anchor_id so that hit/fail windows can be reconstructed for oncall playbooks.

Rollout readiness checklist
- Instrumentation: all required span tags present in 100% of sampled traces for a week.
- Dashboarding: comparison panel included in ops dashboards with toggle and link to rollout notes.
- Cost check: query budget projection signed off by telemetry team.
- Post-promote plan: 2-week burn-in with synthetic probes at 15s cadence and daily review.

Operational runbook snippets
- If shadow v2 diverges > 20% in p95 and trace rate > 0.5% for 12h: open incident triage, tag with hypothesis "metric-shadow-divergence", escalate to eng-observability and serving-runtime.
- To fetch correlated traces: use query trace-anchor=ID and filter span name contains .shadow. Export top 10 traces and attach to Jira.

Open questions and risks
- Sampling bias: are our adaptive sampling heuristics overrepresenting warm paths? Plan: seed small fixed sample for baseline.
- Tenant tagging: some legacy callers don't propagate tenant_id; we must map via token attribution or request headers. Fallback mapping may inflate shadow counts.
- Query cost spikes: high-cardinality by tenant/model may increase backend load. Mitigation: roll shadowing at 10% traffic per tenant then ramp.

Next steps and owners
- Instrumentation PR: Liam Chen (telemetry) - add trace_anchor propagation and span tags - target 2026-01-22.
- Dashboard skeleton: Sofia Martinez (ops-ux) - create comparison panels and tenant heatmap - target 2026-01-25.
- Experiment coord and runbook: Anita Rao - coordinate smoke window and post-analysis - target 2026-02-03.

References and snippets
- Example trace filter: service:inference and trace_attribute.trace_anchor_id:exists and span.name:*.shadow
- Example metric query hint: SELECT percentile(ttf_token_ms, 95) BY tenant_id, model_variant, kv_cache_hit FROM telemetry_shadow.ttf_token_v2 WHERE resolution=30s

Notes to self (scratchpad)
- keep early notes lightweight, add screenshots of dashboards after smoke run.
- remember to update linked_artifacts with incident IDs if anything fires.

End of document
